signature.name: VTask.noncommFold
signature.type: {α : Type u_3} -> (op : α → α → α) -> [assoc : Std.Associative op] -> (s : Multiset α) -> (comm : {x | x ∈ s}.Pairwise fun x y => op x y = op y x) -> α → α

conventions.statement: When s = 0 (the empty multiset), VTask.noncommFold op 0 h a = a for any h and any initial value a.
conventions.note: The pairwise commutativity hypothesis is vacuously true for the empty multiset; the fold simply returns the accumulator.

conventions.statement: When op is globally commutative (a Std.Commutative instance exists), VTask.noncommFold op s (fun x _ y _ _ => Std.Commutative.comm x y) a equals Multiset.fold op a s.
conventions.note: The pairwise-local commutativity proof is subsumed by the global commutative instance, making noncommFold reduce to the ordinary fold.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} (op : α → α → α) [Std.Associative op] (l : List α) (comm : ({x | x ∈ (l : Multiset α)}).Pairwise fun x y => op x y = op y x) (a : α), VTask.noncommFold op (l : Multiset α) comm a = List.foldr op a l

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} (op : α → α → α) [Std.Associative op] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) (h : ({x | x ∈ a ::ₘ s}).Pairwise fun x y => op x y = op y x) (h' : ({x | x ∈ s}).Pairwise fun x y => op x y = op y x) (x : α), VTask.noncommFold op (a ::ₘ s) h x = op a (VTask.noncommFold op s h' x)

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} (op : α → α → α) [Std.Associative op] [Std.Commutative op] (s : Multiset α) (a : α), VTask.noncommFold op s (fun x _ y _ _ => Std.Commutative.comm x y) a = Multiset.fold op a s
